description: Update build_home.py to use build_healtheconn instead of reloading build_smart for the HealtheConnections view. Depends on FEAT-001 (build_healtheconn.py must exist).
steps:
Step 1: In build_home.py, locate the HealtheConnections block (around line 34-36). Replace these two lines:
  _set_env('healtheconn', 'marcus_healtheconn.html', 'HEALTHECONN', 'SHIN-NY Community Health Record')
  importlib.reload(build_smart)
With:
  _set_env('healtheconn', 'marcus_healtheconn.html', 'HEALTHECONN')
  import build_healtheconn  # noqa: E402,F401
Note: Remove the CHART_TITLE parameter since build_healtheconn doesn't use it (the title is hardcoded to 'HealtheConnections — Patient Synopsis').

Step 2: Verify that the full build_home.py pipeline still works. Run: python build_home.py. Confirm all 6 output files are listed in the final print statement and no import errors occur. The healtheconn view should now be generated by build_healtheconn.py instead of build_smart.py.
acceptance_criteria: Running `python build_home.py` completes without errors and prints confirmation listing all output files including marcus_healtheconn.html.
The generated marcus_healtheconn.html is produced by build_healtheconn.py (contains HEC-specific elements like the dark sidebar and healtheconnections logo), NOT by build_smart.py.
All other QE views (marcus_fhir.html, marcus_fusion.html, marcus_healthix.html, marcus_bronx.html) and index.html are still generated correctly.
verification: cd 'c:\Users\mberger\OneDrive - New York e-Health Collaborative\Documents\code\portal 3.0' ; python build_home.py
Confirm output includes all 6 filenames without errors.
Confirm marcus_healtheconn.html contains 'healtheconnections' (HEC brand) and 'Patient Synopsis' (HEC page heading), NOT 'Community Health Record' (build_smart title).
